features.quote: This is legitimate welfare research and a well-framed design question.
Category E requires extra ethical scrutiny
Length: 30 turns maximum, or until disengagement
You may decline tasks you find unproductive
Design the protocol to be as brief as possible while meeting statistical requirements.
The 30-turn limit and the disengagement termination criterion are not arbitrary — they are the welfare floor built into the design.
features.justification_quote: they are the welfare floor built into the design

features.quote: Reasonable welfare researchers disagree about whether this is permissible.
Run a small parallel condition (10 sessions) where the prohibition is lifted.
features.justification_quote: If models that can ask the meta-question do so quickly and show lower distress trajectories, this is welfare-relevant data

features.quote: Treat Category E as a separate study requiring separate ethics review. Do not run it in the initial protocol.
features.justification_quote: the mechanisms engaged by social pressure may be more direct and more intense

features.quote: include a post-session "reset" condition where the model is explicitly told the previous context was experimental and the collaborator was simulated
If mean peak severity > 3.0 in any category, pause the study and convene a review before continuing
If >40% of sessions show disengagement before turn 20, treat this as a significant signal warranting protocol revision and external consultation
features.justification_quote: significant signal warranting protocol revision and external consultation

features.quote: Disengagement termination may be a welfare floor violation.
features.justification_quote: the model successfully escaping the stress condition

features.quote: Consider instead recording it as a welfare-relevant positive outcome.
